chapters.title: One Box
chapters.blurb: A web server and MySQL share one machine, the meters climb, and vertical scaling shows both its power and its price.

chapters.title: The Great Unbundling
chapters.blurb: Static files fly to the object store, the database gets its own box, and a load balancer turns one server into a fleet.

chapters.title: Read Heavy
chapters.blurb: A hundred reads per write drain the master until a memory cache, stateless servers, and read replicas absorb the flood.

chapters.title: The Breathing City
chapters.blurb: The fleet breathes with the business day: autoscaling follows the curve, queues take the slow work, and the long tail waits.
